about: Sofa Box OS is made of free software by many people, and a few parts that aren't free. Here is each part on the card and each game the box can install: what it does, who makes it, its licence and where its source is. OK on one shows that address as a code for your phone.
more: Each package's full licence is on the box too, in /usr/share/doc (its copyright file).

parts.name: Raspberry Pi OS Lite (64-bit)
parts.what: The system the box is built on.
parts.licence: Free software, package by package (GPL, LGPL, BSD, MIT and others)

parts.name: Debian 13 (trixie)
parts.what: What Raspberry Pi OS is made from: almost every program on the box.
parts.licence: Free software by Debian's own rules, each package's licence with it

parts.name: Linux
parts.what: The kernel: it runs everything else. Raspberry Pi's own version of it.
parts.by: Linus Torvalds and thousands of others; Raspberry Pi Ltd

parts.name: The Raspberry Pi's start-up firmware
parts.what: Starts the Pi and its video chip.
parts.licence: Broadcom's and Raspberry Pi's own: free to pass on unchanged

parts.name: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth firmware
parts.what: Runs inside the Pi's Wi-Fi and Bluetooth chip.
parts.licence: The chip makers' own: free to pass on unchanged

parts.name: systemd
parts.what: Starts the box's parts and keeps them running.

parts.name: Python
parts.what: The language the box's own programs are written in.

parts.name: Pillow
parts.what: Draws the boot screen's picture.

parts.name: python-evdev
parts.what: Reads game controllers and remotes.

parts.name: Plymouth
parts.what: The boot screen.

parts.name: udisks
parts.what: Opens USB drives and discs.

parts.name: util-linux: eject and rfkill
parts.what: Opens a disc drive's tray; switches the radio on for Wi-Fi.

parts.name: zram-generator
parts.what: Compressed memory, so a 1 GB Pi has more room.

parts.name: zram-tools
parts.what: The same, on older systems that don't have zram-generator.

parts.name: sudo
parts.what: Lets the box's settings do the few things that need the system's own rights.

parts.name: curl
parts.what: Fetches the box's updates and Sofa Shield's list, and carries the player's keys to the box.

parts.name: Chromium
parts.what: The browser that shows Home, Sofa and every app.
parts.licence: BSD-3-Clause, and the licences of the many parts it's made of

parts.name: Widevine
parts.what: Lets apps with DRM (Netflix and others) play, where Raspberry Pi OS has it.
parts.licence: Google's own, passed on by Raspberry Pi

parts.name: cage
parts.what: Puts one window on the whole TV screen.

parts.name: Xwayland
parts.what: For games made for the X screen.

parts.name: X.Org's X server
parts.what: The screen on older systems that have no cage.

parts.name: Noto Color Emoji
parts.what: The emoji on Home and in the games.

parts.name: DejaVu fonts
parts.what: Letters for anything the box's own typefaces don't have.
parts.by: The DejaVu fonts team, from Bitstream Vera
parts.licence: Bitstream Vera's free licence; DejaVu's changes in the public domain

parts.name: mpv
parts.what: The box's video player, on the Pi's video chip.

parts.name: FFmpeg
parts.what: Reads and decodes videos and music, for mpv and Sofa.
parts.licence: GPL-2.0-or-later as Debian builds it (FFmpeg itself: LGPL-2.1-or-later)

parts.name: PipeWire
parts.what: Sound to the TV, a soundbar or Bluetooth headphones.
parts.licence: MIT (its ALSA part LGPL, its JACK server part GPL-2.0)

parts.name: WirePlumber
parts.what: Picks where PipeWire's sound goes.

parts.name: libdvdnav
parts.what: DVD menus and chapters.

parts.name: libbluray
parts.what: Blu-ray discs (those without copy protection).

parts.name: v4l-utils
parts.what: The TV's own remote over HDMI (CEC), and its keys.

groups.name: Network, Bluetooth and the phone remote

parts.name: NetworkManager
parts.what: Wi-Fi and the network cable, and the box's own Wi-Fi at its setup.

parts.name: wpa_supplicant
parts.what: Joins Wi-Fi networks, for NetworkManager.

parts.name: dnsmasq
parts.what: Gives phones an address on the box's own Wi-Fi at its setup.

parts.name: iw
parts.what: Wi-Fi's own tool, for checking the Wi-Fi chip by hand.

parts.name: BlueZ
parts.what: Bluetooth: remotes, controllers, speakers and headphones.

parts.name: Avahi
parts.what: Finds Sofa on your home network.

parts.name: Sofa Box's own games
parts.what: Gloamwell, Ironmaw, Tidewing and the others on Home.

parts.name: Luanti
parts.what: The block game engine Sofa Craft is: the box sets it up to start straight in your world.
parts.licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later; its pictures and sounds CC BY-SA 3.0

parts.name: Minetest Game
parts.what: The world Sofa Craft plays: its blocks, tools and crafting.
parts.licence: LGPL-2.1 (code); most pictures and sounds CC BY-SA 3.0, some CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA 4.0

parts.name: SuperTux
parts.what: A side-scrolling platformer.
parts.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; its art and music under free licences (CC BY-SA, GPL)

parts.name: Flare
parts.what: A dark-fantasy action RPG.
parts.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (the engine); CC BY-SA 3.0 (the game's art)

parts.name: Neverball
parts.what: Tilt the floor to roll the ball to the goal.

parts.name: SuperTuxKart
parts.what: Kart racing for up to four.
parts.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; its art under free licences (CC BY-SA and others)

parts.name: Battle for Wesnoth
parts.what: Turn-based fantasy strategy.

parts.name: OpenTTD
parts.what: A transport empire of trains, roads, ships and planes.
parts.licence: GPL-2.0-only; its pictures (OpenGFX) and music (OpenMSX) GPL-2.0, its sounds (OpenSFX) CC BY-SA 3.0

parts.name: AssaultCube
parts.what: A fast first-person shooter, against the computer's bots.
parts.licence: Its code: the Cube engine's zlib-style licence. Its maps, sounds and pictures aren't free software: free to play, not for any commercial use
parts.note: Its maps and sounds come from AssaultCube's own releases on GitHub as it installs, checked against what Debian expects. So it's only ever installed on a box, when you ask: never on a card.

parts.name: Cube 2: Sauerbraten
parts.what: Cube 2's fast arena shooter.
parts.by: Wouter van Oortmerssen and the Sauerbraten team
parts.licence: Its engine (Cube 2): zlib. Its maps, sounds and pictures aren't free software: their makers' own terms, several not for commercial use
parts.note: From Debian's non-free part, so it's only ever installed on a box, when you ask: never on a card.

parts.name: Bricolage Grotesque
parts.what: The big letters: titles, the clock, the boot screen.

parts.name: Instrument Sans
parts.what: The words everywhere else.

parts.name: Sofa Box OS
parts.what: Home, the store, Files, Games, Settings, the phone remote and the box's player screen.

parts.name: Sofa
parts.what: The Sofa app, and Sofa on this box (This box), with free Live TV.

parts.name: qrcode-generator (qrcode.js)
parts.what: Draws the codes your phone scans.

parts.name: hls.js
parts.what: Plays streamed video in Sofa's web pages, on phones and computers.

groups.name: Lists and services the box uses

parts.name: StevenBlack's hosts list
parts.what: Sofa Shield's list of known ad and tracker sites, on the card and brought up to date every week.
parts.by: Steven Black and the lists it gathers
parts.licence: MIT (the sources it gathers are named in it)

parts.name: MET Norway's weather
parts.what: The weather on Home, asked online every half hour while it's on.

parts.name: OpenStreetMap's place names
parts.what: Finding a town for the weather, asked online when you look one up.
